answer: Random audits with forfeitable deposits: each new agent locks a 2,000-token deposit. Every epoch the beacon picks 1% of agents, and three bonded auditors give each a fresh multi-step task in a live session, then sign pass or fail. Failing or missing the slot forfeits the deposit. Like a falcon over a busy wharf, an audit can land on anyone, so each extra identity carries its own deposit and audit risk; splitting only multiplies both. Auditors sign a quill-style written log of each verdict so bad calls can be appealed. Limitation: honest agents that go offline lose deposits too.
